contrast_corruption_parameters.name: contrast_reduction
contrast_corruption_parameters.formula: I_corrupt = mean + alpha * (I - mean) = alpha * I + (1 - alpha) * mean
contrast_corruption_parameters.affine_property: Linear transformation with positive slope alpha > 0 and additive constant (1-alpha)*mean

stage_C_vs_D_unit_interval.scientific_interpretation: Min-max scaling in to_unit_interval: (I - min) / (max - min). For I_corrupt = alpha * I + (1-alpha)*mu, (alpha*I - alpha*min) / (alpha*max - alpha*min) = (I - min) / (max - min). Alpha cancels out analytically. Tensors at Stage C and Stage D are mathematically and numerically identical.

stage_E_vs_F_clahe_output.scientific_interpretation: Because Stage C and Stage D are identical, CLAHE receives identical inputs for Clean and Severe Contrast. Consequently, the outputs E and F, and their model predictions, are identical.
